title: “I didn’t realize how much I needed peace until I watched Him speak.”
paragraphs: “I didn’t realize how much I needed peace until I watched Him speak.”
When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly.

The room is calm. Lamps flicker. Jesus speaks of peace—not as the world gives, but something deeper, steadier. I am not part of the conversation. I am only a witness. And yet, my heart feels addressed.
In the hush of the evening, I notice how His words don’t rush fear away—they replace it with rest.
What kind of peace am I carrying tonight? And what might change if I trusted His peace to stay?
